entities.summary: Phaedrus, son of Pythocles, of the Myrrhinus deme, was an ancient Athenian aristocrat associated with the inner-circle of the philosopher Socrates. He was indicted in the profanation of the Eleusinian Mysteries in 415 BC during the Peloponnesian War, causing him to flee Athens. Phaedrus was a philosophers & thinkers from Athens (443 BCE, Athens–392 BCE). Recognized as a landmark figure with global significance (referenced in 0 Wikipedia editions).
